contracts.purpose: Define user needs and outcomes as a testable agreement.

inputs.description: User intent, target users, constraints and desired outcomes.

outputs.description: Validated feature specification and acceptance scenarios.

acceptance_criteria: User scenarios are independently testable and prioritized.
Requirements and success criteria are testable, bounded and unambiguous.
Assumptions and edge cases are recorded.

contracts.purpose: Connect the approved specification to an evidence-based implementation design.

outputs.description: Technical plan with architecture and validation strategy.
Human-approved validation scenarios and expected outcomes.

acceptance_criteria: The plan addresses the specification and project governance.
Open technical decisions are resolved or explicitly bounded.
Validation commands are proposed for human approval before construction checkpoints.
review_focus: Security, data handling and operational limits

contracts.purpose: Translate the approved design into dependency-ordered, independently testable work.

inputs.description: The approved implementation plan and design artifacts.
Prioritized user stories and acceptance scenarios.

outputs.description: Story-organized tasks with dependencies, paths and verification.

acceptance_criteria: Every user story maps to implementation and verification tasks.
Dependencies and parallel opportunities are explicit.
Each task is concrete, path-specific and follows the project task format.
review_focus: Task clarity, ordering and independent testability

contracts.purpose: Deliver the approved tasks while preserving behavior and recording verification.

inputs.description: Verification commands approved by a human.

outputs.description: Code changes mapped to the approved tasks.
Test and quality-check outcomes recorded in the feature artifacts.

acceptance_criteria: Implementation follows approved task dependencies and requirements.
Verification outcomes are recorded, and failures are surfaced explicitly.
Human approvals and user-owned changes are preserved.
review_focus: Scope and preservation of unrelated work
